purpose: Small externally sourced evaluation of demo/src/financial-tables on transaction rows and invoice summary values. Not a deployment, authenticity, income or SOTA claim.
access: TRAIN/DEV only. Bankstatemently bsb-001..003 (bsb-004/005 reserved, unfetched). Synthesized bank-statement-syn-0042 clean/scanned/fax. FATURA TRAIN and DEV layouts from experiments/public_documents/protocol.json; reserved layouts are never extracted. No TEST, reserved media or lists.

synthesized.gold: Publisher truth.json (CC BY 4.0, synthetic): transactions[date, description, amount], running_balances, opening_balance, closing_balance, total_deposits, total_withdrawals. Amounts converted float->decimal via repr, two decimals. Account perspective: positive = money in.
synthesized.independence: Publisher annotation; never derived from OCR, text layer or extractor.

bankstatemently.gold: Explicit transcription of every transaction row from the pinned 144 dpi renders by visual reading, recorded 2026-10-25 before any OCR or extractor run on this protocol. Checked before freezing against publisher statement-info transactionCount (12/15/22), the printed opening/closing balances and totals (exact decimal), and line presence in the publisher text layer (148/148 lines present, zero gold changes).
bankstatemently.independence: Publisher server-side transaction truth is NOT available locally and is not claimed. This is single-annotator transcription with arithmetic closure; descriptions are second-checked only by text-layer presence.
bankstatemently.direction: bsb-002 is a credit card: printed positive = charge = money out for the cardholder; account-perspective sign is the negation of the printed amount. bsb-002 undated 0.00 continuation lines are decoys, not transactions.

fatura_dev.documents: 50 DEV invoices (5 layouts x 10 instances) from experiments/public_documents/manifest.json
fatura_dev.gold: Publisher region annotations SUB_TOTAL, TAX and GST(n%), DISCOUNT, TOTAL (else AMOUNT_DUE). Value = last decimal number in the annotation text. TABLE annotations are geometry only: there is NO line-item truth, so no row/cell precision is reported for invoices.
fatura_dev.arithmetic: Gold total arithmetic is computed from the annotations (subtotal - discount + taxes). Where it does not equal the annotated total the gold invoice_total check is inconsistent; an extractor 'consistent' on it is a false consistent.

fatura_train.gold: As fatura_dev. Used only to look for failures; never reported as accuracy.

arms.ocr_ppocr_v6_tiny: Native text_v6 CLI (PP-OCRv6 tiny, the demo's financial default reader) built from HEAD 0526c5d into a private target, without --detail, on the pinned renders: Synthesized 150 dpi PNGs, Bankstatemently 144 dpi PNGs, FATURA JPGs. Lines in original pixels, as demo/src/financial-data.ts passes them. One process per page, at most two processes, RTEN/RAYON threads 1, 180 s timeout. A failed page is passed as failedPages and its gold stays in the denominator.
arms.native_text_diagnostic: PDF.js (demo's pdfjs-dist 6.4.299, legacy build) getTextContent items -> linesFromPdfTextItems, for the Synthesized clean PDF and the three Bankstatemently PDFs. A localisation diagnostic only: never pooled with OCR, never trusted, never authentication.

extractor_call: One extractFinancialTables call per document with every page in order, fileIndex 0, options {} (auto, as the demo calls it) plus source/trustStatus. No per-document options, no gold-derived hints.

scoring.rows: Predicted transaction rows = rows of kind 'transaction' in bank tables, in report order. Gold rows in printed order. Alignment = longest common subsequence where a pair matches iff the predicted parsed magnitude (amount, debit or credit cell) equals the gold magnitude exactly. Unaligned gold rows are missed; unaligned predicted transaction rows are extra (false rows). No bag-of-values matching: every cell is scored on its aligned row only.

cells.date: Predicted iso equals gold date or alt_date (bsb-002 post/trans date). Null iso is a miss.
cells.amount: Signed account-perspective value: direction credit -> +, debit -> -, unknown/none -> abstained (counted, not correct).
cells.balance: Exact decimal equality where gold has a running balance (Synthesized, bsb-001).
cells.description: Normalised (NFKC, casefold, non-alphanumeric -> space, collapsed) gold primary line contained in the normalised predicted description. Strict full-text equality reported separately as a diagnostic.

scoring.row_exact: Aligned and every applicable cell correct.
scoring.summary: Bank: opening (opening_balance|brought_forward), closing (closing_balance|carried_forward), total_debits, total_credits where gold has them. Invoices: subtotal, tax_total (one opportunity per gold tax annotation), discount (magnitude), invoice_total. Correct iff some predicted field of the key equals gold (Decimal); wrong iff fields exist and none equal; missing otherwise. Conflicting distinct values are counted.

checks.supported_consistent: A predicted 'consistent' check whose every cited row is aligned with correct amount (and balance where applicable) and whose every cited summary field equals gold, and whose gold arithmetic holds.
checks.false_consistent: A predicted 'consistent' check citing an extra row, a misread cited cell, a summary value differing from gold, or a relation the gold says is inconsistent (FATURA totals).
checks.unverifiable_consistent: A 'consistent' check that cites unannotated rows (invoice line items). Counted, never called precision.
checks.gold_coverage: For each bank document, gold-evaluable relations (running_balance where printed, opening_plus_credits_minus_debits_equals_closing): predicted status consistent / inconsistent / not_evaluable / absent.

scoring.false_income: false_credit_rows: aligned rows predicted credit whose gold amount is negative. false_income_candidates: recurring_credit_candidate observations or salary_like classifications citing any row that is not an aligned gold credit row.
scoring.abstentions: Report-level abstentions, failed pages and documents with no bank table keep all their gold rows in the denominator.
scoring.denominators: Every gold row, cell, summary opportunity and check of every listed document, per arm. Nothing is excluded after inference.

candidate: One generalised failure is chosen from discovery outputs (Bankstatemently, FATURA TRAIN). The candidate lives only in a private snapshot plus experiments/financial_external/candidate.patch. It is reported paired against baseline on every set, plus the authored regression (experiments/financial_tables fixtures main/stress/review/review3 and demo/test/financial-tables.test.mjs) run in a private mirror. Synthesized and FATURA DEV are confirmation sets: in-sample discovery effects are labelled as such.
privacy: Raw media, gold values, OCR text and predictions stay owner-private under /tmp/docscan-public-data/financial-external-v1 (umask 077). Committed-eligible files hold hashes, counts and ids only.
limits: Three Bankstatemently layouts, one Synthesized identity (three correlated variants), five FATURA DEV layouts without line-item truth. No confidence intervals, no population, deployment, South African or real-document claims.
